task.name: Matrix multiplication 2,2,14
task.description: Find a rank-minimal exact tensor decomposition for multiplying a 2 by 2 matrix by a 2 by 14 matrix. The output factor follows the official trace convention W[k*n+i,r].
task.contract: construct() -> {'U', 'V', 'W'}: factor matrices of shapes (n*m, rank), (m*p, rank), (p*n, rank) with integer/half-integer entries that exactly decompose the matrix multiplication tensor; score is the rank
